name: Don VanMatre
background: Don VanMatre is a Sinclair, Carbon County resident (mailing city on the candidate filing) who ran as the Constitution Party nominee for Senate District 11 and lost the Nov. 3, 2026 general election, as already recorded from official results.

He was listed as the Constitution Party speaker for Senate District 11 at a Carbon County Higher Education Center general-election forum, and local Rocket-Miner coverage of a 2026 forum and ballot “who's who” was already cited in the research store. A new search of public sources for this fill did not find an occupation, education, or military record.
